_doc: Weather tile (#318): emulator src/core/weather.ts (weatherError, wxIcon, wxEntries, weatherView). Firmware: core/weather.cpp, test_core test_weather_vectors. Times epoch ms; tz = local UTC offset in minutes; now = 2026-10-26T14:37:00+00:00. config: like config/*.json. icons: HA condition → drawing. entries: a weather.get_forecasts list → kept entries (t, icon, temp, low, mm; null = absent). views: entity state + attributes + both lists (raw, through wxEntries) → the tile text.

config.name: weather-full-and-half
config.description: A weather tile on a weather.* entity, full width: rs 2 (full screen) or rs 1 (top half), with a label.

expect.yaml:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    app: home
    title: a
    widgets:
      - {type: weather, entity: weather.home, cs: 4, rs: 2}
  - id: b
    app: home
    title: b
    widgets:
      - {type: weather, entity: weather.forecast_home, label: Outside, cs: 4}
      - {type: clock, cs: 4}

config.name: weather-not-full-width
config.description: Rule: a weather tile is full width (cs: 4).
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1

      - {type: weather, entity: weather.home, cs: 2, rs: 2}

config.name: weather-default-width
config.description: Rule: no cs is 1 wide, not full width.
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1

config.name: weather-wrong-domain
config.description: Rule: the entity must be a weather.* id.
config.input:
# HA Paper display config
version: 1
screens:
  - id: a
    widgets:
      - {type: weather, entity: sensor.outdoor_temperature, cs: 4}

expect.message: weather: “sensor.outdoor_temperature” is not a weather entity

entries.name: daily
entries.description: Daily from today (local date, tz +60): yesterday skipped, entries without a valid datetime skipped, at most 7; numbers to 2 decimals, a numeric string read, a missing field null.

entries.name: daily-json-string
entries.description: The same list as JSON text.

entries.name: hourly
entries.description: Hourly from the hour holding now (15:00 local): earlier hours skipped, at most 16.

views.name: full-en
views.description: Partly cloudy, feels 10°, high / low from today, 4 Bft SW, rain from 19:00 (18:00 UTC), the next 5 days with bars scaled to 10 mm or the wettest day.

views.name: full-nl
views.description: The same in Dutch: decimal comma, ZW, vanaf 19:00, short weekday names.

views.name: kmh-text-bearing
views.description: Wind in km/h, a text bearing kept as is; no apparent_temperature = no "feels"; rain in the hour holding now = "now".

views.name: no-precipitation
views.description: Hourly entries without precipitation: wet by condition (snowy at 22:00); bearing 350° = N; an unknown condition by name.

views.name: dry
views.description: No wet hour in the next 12 h: "none soon".

views.name: no-forecast
views.description: No forecast answer yet (null): high / low / rain "—", no strip.

views.name: unavailable
views.description: Unavailable entity: the gap, no temperature, no wind; the forecast still shows.

views.name: inches-west
views.description: precipitation_unit in: bars scaled to at least 0.4 in; tz -300 shifts the local dates (today = the 26th).
